title: Vperk - Immortal Village Perks
body:
Syntax: vperk list
        vperk status [village|all]
        vperk <village|all> <perk> on|off
        vperk on|off <village|all> <perk>

Immortals (helper rank or higher) can enable or disable any village perk without spending mission points. An enabled perk affects all ninja belonging to the chosen village for 24 hours and persists across a crash or reboot. Re-enabling refreshes the timer. 'all' targets every village. Only one perk per category (EXP, damage, Ryo) can be active as an immortal override at a time; turning on another in the same category replaces the prior one. Turning a perk off removes that specific override. Kage-bought perks remain separate and continue using their normal one-hour duration.

Examples:
  vperk list
  vperk status leaf
  vperk leaf double exp on
  vperk leaf double exp off
  vperk water triple damage on
  vperk all double ryo on
  vperk all double ryo off

Perks: double exp, triple exp, double damage, triple damage, double ryo, triple ryo.

These commands are staff-only; perks take effect immediately and are announced to affected villages.

Date: 2026-10-24
